visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, chestnut-brown hair and bangs stands in front of a beige curtain background. She is wearing a cream-colored top and holds a white iPhone 17 Pro box. She smiles brightly at the camera. (2) She moves the box closer to the lens, then proceeds to tap the box surface and pull the paper sealing tabs on the back. Her fingernails are manicured with a pink and white design. (3) She reveals the silver iPhone 17 Pro, showing the triple-camera module on the back. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the metallic sheen of the device. (4) She slowly peels the protective white paper film off the front screen of the phone, holding it vertically. (5) She showcases the interior of the box, displaying the SIM tool, a coiled Type-C cable, and a set of paper manuals spread out in her hands. (6) The phone is shown turning on with the white Apple logo on a black screen. Later, she shows the vibrant blue/green lock screen. (7) She unboxes a transparent RhinoShield clear case from a brown cardboard package and snaps it onto the silver phone. (8) She holds the new silver iPhone 17 Pro side-by-side with a gold/natural titanium iPhone 16 Pro for size and aesthetic comparison.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice greets the audience over a bright, mid-tempo electronic BGM. The BGM features a steady synth bass and crisp electronic percussion. (2) Frequent percussive tapping sounds (finger on box) punctuate the speech. The speaker's tone is bubbly and enthusiastic. (3) A distinct, long 'zipper-like' peeling SFX occurs as the box seal is pulled, followed by a lighter rustling sound. (4) A satisfying 'sticky' peeling SFX is heard as the screen protector is removed. The speaker makes soft 'ooh' vocalizations. (5) Rapid rustling of paper manuals and the metallic click of a SIM pin hitting the table. (6) A mechanical sliding sound occurs as the phone is put into the case, ending with a sharp plastic snap/click SFX. (7) Comparison commentary continues with the speaker using a higher pitch and faster rate to express excitement, accompanied by a cartoonish 'pop' sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Unboxing -> Accessory Showcase -> Feature Testing -> Brand Endorsement -> Comparison.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the unboxing experience and aesthetic of the new iPhone 17 Pro in silver, while cross-promoting the RhinoShield phone case as a compatible and stylish accessory.
